_about: Ad hooks for message match: /breathe?h=<id> puts the ad's exact first line in the headline slot and preselects its session (variants a-e). The seven lines are the ads' own (lead, 28 Sep); unknown ids are ignored. Swedish lines not written yet. sub_en: the line under the headline in variant f (what happens next, echoing the ad's end card). 'night' is a draft from the landing loop; no ad uses it yet. {guide} in a line is the chosen session's narrator. world: the colour world the ad ends in (the ads loop, 28 Sep: foggy ember, overloaded water, can't switch off night, challenger ember); the page's first frame opens in it. card_en, edge_sub_en and start_f (variant f's `edge` flag): card_en replaces the hook session's tile line in variant f. start_f: where that session's playback starts for this hook in variant f (keepup: 'We'll move through three breathing techniques, each one building in intensity').

coffee.sub_en: Try 6 minutes of breathing with {guide} instead. Free, no app needed.

email.sub_en: 6 minutes of breathing with {guide} first. Free, no app needed.

parked.line_en: Parked outside. Not ready to go in.
parked.sub_en: Take 6 minutes with {guide} first. Free, no app needed.

slowest.line_en: The slowest breath of your day.
slowest.sub_en: 6 minutes of slow breathing with {guide}. Free, no app needed.

exhale.sub_en: Find out in 6 minutes with {guide}. Free, no app needed.

rate.sub_en: Ask again after 6 minutes with {guide}. Free, no app needed.

keepup.line_en: Can you keep up with this?
keepup.sub_en: Fast breaths, then a long hold. 6 minutes with {guide}, free.
keepup.edge_sub_en: Each round builds, then a long hold. 6 minutes with {guide}, free.

night.sub_en: 6 slow minutes with {guide}. Fine to do lying down. Free.
night.draft: landing loop, 28 Sep: a line for the one who can't switch off; no ad uses it yet (for the ads loop)
